errors.signInRequired: Sign in with ChatGPT or your own API key first. Lalime needs your account before it can help.
errors.codexMissing: Codex is not installed on this PC yet. Install it once, then sign in, or paste your OpenAI API key instead.
errors.handsMissing: Computer control is off because Hands.exe was not found. On Windows, run npm run build (needs .NET 8), then restart Lalime.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. You can try again in a moment.
onboarding.welcome.title: Your computer, done for you.
onboarding.welcome.body: Tell Lalime what you need in everyday words. It clicks, cleans up, and fixes things so you do not have to hunt through menus.
onboarding.guardian.title: Nothing dangerous happens behind your back.
onboarding.guardian.body: Before anything risky, Lalime asks in plain English. Dangerous commands are blocked. You can undo tidy-ups from the Recycle Bin.
onboarding.signin.title: Use your own ChatGPT or API key.
onboarding.signin.body: Every person brings their own login. Sign in with ChatGPT, or paste an OpenAI API key. Lalime never ships a shared account.
onboarding.writer.title: Clearer replies (optional).
onboarding.writer.body: You can add an Anthropic API key so replies use Jackson’s Deliberate writing style. Without it, Lalime still works and shows the usual Codex text.
settings.signInBlurb: Every person uses their own ChatGPT account or OpenAI API key. Lalime never ships a shared login.
settings.writerBlurb: Paste an Anthropic API key so replies are rewritten in clearer everyday English. Codex still does the work. Without a key, nothing changes.
settings.writerSaved: Writing key saved on this PC. Only the last four characters are shown here.
settings.writerRemoved: Writing key removed. Replies will use the regular Codex text.
empty.title: What do you need help with?
empty.body: Ask in everyday words. Lalime shows its plan, asks before anything risky, and keeps Undo nearby.
gate.title: Sign in to continue
gate.body: Lalime talks to Codex with your ChatGPT account or your own OpenAI API key. There is no shared demo bot.
chips.downloads: Sort my Downloads folder and clean up the mess.
chips.forms: Help me fill a form or update a spreadsheet.
chips.programs: Open a program, click the buttons, and type for me.
approval.hold: This is a more serious change. Take a second before confirming.
